v32-1.display:
Give ear, O heaven, and I will speak;
and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

v32-2.display:
Let my utterance be awaited as the rain,
and let my words descend as the dew,
as a shower upon the grass,
and as snow upon the herbage.

v32-3.display:
For I have called upon the name of the Lord;
ascribe greatness unto our God.

v32-6.display:
Do you thus repay the Lord,
O foolish people and unwise?
Is not He Himself your Father, who acquired you,
and made you, and created you?

v32-8.display:
When the Most High divided the nations,
when He scattered the sons of Adam,
He set the bounds of the nations
according to the number of the angels of God.

v32-9.display:
And His people Jacob became the portion of the Lord;
Israel, the measured lot of His inheritance.

v32-10.display:
He sustained him in a wilderness land,
in the thirst of burning heat, in a waterless place;
He compassed him about, and instructed him,
and kept him as the pupil of an eye.

v32-11.display:
As an eagle would shelter its nest,
it yearned over its young;
spreading its wings, it received them,
and took them up upon its back.

v32-12.display:
The Lord alone led them,
and there was no foreign god with them.

v32-13.display:
He brought them up upon the strength of the earth,
and fed them the produce of the fields;
they sucked honey out of the rock,
and oil out of the solid rock,

v32-14.display:
butter of cattle and milk of sheep,
with the fat of lambs and rams,
young bulls and goats,
with the fat of the kernels of wheat;
and they drank wine, the blood of the grape.

v32-16.display:
They provoked Me with foreign gods;
with their abominations they embittered Me.

v32-17.display:
They sacrificed unto demons, and not unto God,
unto gods whom they did not know;
new ones, lately come,
whom their fathers did not know.

v32-18.display:
You forsook God who begat you,
and forgot God who nourishes you.

v32-19.display:
And the Lord saw, and was jealous,
and was provoked by the anger of His sons and daughters.

v32-22.display:
For a fire has been kindled out of My wrath;
it shall burn unto Hades beneath,
devour the earth and its produce,
and set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.

v32-23.display:
I will gather evils against them,
and spend My arrows upon them.

v32-24.display:
They shall waste away with hunger, and be devoured by birds,
and suffer incurable backward-bending spasms;
I will send against them the teeth of wild beasts,
with the fury of things that crawl upon the ground.

v32-25.display:
Without, the sword shall bereave them;
and from the inner chambers, terror:
the young man together with the maiden,
the nursing child with the aged elder.

v32-26.display:
I said, I will scatter them;
I will make their remembrance cease from among men,

v32-27.display:
were it not for the wrath of enemies, lest they endure long,
and lest the adversaries join in the attack;
lest they say, Our hand is exalted,
and the Lord has not done all these things.

v32-28.display:
For it is a nation that has lost counsel,
and there is no knowledge in them.

v32-29.display:
They did not have the wisdom to understand these things;
let them receive them for the time to come.

v32-30.display:
How shall one pursue a thousand,
and two put tens of thousands to flight,
unless God had sold them,
and the Lord had delivered them up?

v32-31.display:
For their gods are not as our God;
and our enemies are without understanding.

v32-32.display:
For their vine is of the vine of Sodom,
and their tendril is of Gomorrah;
their grape is a grape of gall,
their cluster is bitterness.

v32-33.display:
Their wine is the venom of serpents,
and the incurable venom of asps.

v32-34.display:
Behold, are not these things gathered with Me,
and sealed in My treasuries?

v32-37.display:
And the Lord said, Where are their gods,
in whom they trusted,

v32-38.display:
whose sacrifices’ fat you ate,
and whose drink offerings’ wine you drank?
Let them arise and help you,
and become your protectors.

v32-40.display:
For I will lift My hand unto heaven,
and swear by My right hand,
and say, I live for ever.

v32-41.display:
For I will sharpen My sword as lightning,
and My hand shall lay hold of judgment;
and I will repay a penalty unto the enemies,
and unto them that hate Me will I repay.

v32-42.display:
I will make My arrows drunk with blood,
and My sword shall devour flesh,
from the blood of the slain and of captives,
from the head of the rulers of the enemies.

v33-2.display:
And he said,
The Lord has come from Sinai,
and appeared unto us from Seir,
and hastened from Mount Paran with myriads of Kadesh;
at His right hand were angels with Him.

v33-4.display:
the law which Moses commanded us,
an inheritance for the assemblies of Jacob.

v33-5.display:
And there shall be a ruler in the beloved,
when the rulers of the peoples are gathered together
with the tribes of Israel.

v33-6.display:
Let Reuben live, and not die;
and let him be many in number.

v33-7.display:
And this for Judah:
Hear, O Lord, the voice of Judah,
and let them enter unto his people;
his hands shall contend for him,
and Thou shalt be a helper against his enemies.

v33-8.display:
And unto Levi he said,
Give unto Levi his manifestations,
and his truth unto the holy man,
whom they tested in a trial,
and reviled at the water of dispute;

v33-9.display:
who says unto his father and his mother, I have not seen you;
and he did not acknowledge his brethren,
and disowned his sons.
He kept Thine oracles,
and preserved Thy covenant.

v33-10.display:
They shall declare Thine ordinances unto Jacob,
and Thy law unto Israel;
they shall lay incense in Thy wrath,
continually upon Thine altar.

v33-11.display:
Bless, O Lord, his strength,
and accept the works of his hands;
break the loin of the enemies who rise against him,
and let not them that hate him arise.

v33-12.display:
And unto Benjamin he said,
He who is beloved of the Lord shall dwell in confidence;
and God overshadows him all the days,
and between his shoulders He rested.

v33-13.display:
And unto Joseph he said,
From the blessing of the Lord is his land,
from the seasons of heaven and the dew,
and from the springs of the depths beneath,

v33-14.display:
and in the season of the produce of the sun’s turnings,
and from the conjunctions of the months,

v33-15.display:
and from the summit of the ancient mountains,
and from the summit of the everlasting hills,

v33-16.display:
and in the season of the fullness of the earth.
And may the things acceptable unto Him who appeared in the bush
come upon the head of Joseph,
and upon the crown of him who was glorified among his brethren.

v33-20.display:
And unto Gad he said,
Blessed is He that enlarges Gad;
as a lion he rested,
having crushed an arm and a ruler.

v33-21.display:
And he saw his first portion;
for there was apportioned the land of rulers
gathered together with the leaders of the peoples.
The Lord wrought righteousness,
and His judgment with Israel.

v33-22.display:
And unto Dan he said,
Dan is a lion’s cub,
and shall leap forth from Bashan.

v33-24.display:
And unto Asher he said,
Asher is blessed with children,
and shall be acceptable unto his brethren;
he shall dip his foot in oil.

v33-25.display:
His sandal shall be iron and bronze;
and as your days, so shall your strength be.

v33-26.display:
There is none like the God of the beloved,
who rides upon heaven as your helper,
the majestic One of the firmament.

v33-27.display:
And there is shelter from the God of old,
and you are under the strength of everlasting arms;
and He shall drive out the enemy from before your face,
saying, May you perish.

v33-28.display:
And Israel shall dwell in confidence,
alone upon the land of Jacob,
with grain and wine;
and the heaven for him shall be clouded with dew.

v33-29.display:
Blessed are you, O Israel!
Who is like unto you, a people saved by the Lord?
Your helper shall shield you,
and the sword is your boast;
and your enemies shall lie unto you,
and you shall tread upon their neck.
